text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I worked really hard in training
today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! As a reward, I'll watch some of the
sumo
matches I recorded. ♪ I wonder
what kind of
winning techniques—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You can't be serious! That was the grand

champion's final match before
retirement, too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her failure to record an extremely
important
sumo match leaves Sakura
Chiyono O deeply
depressed...
